exactselection.polygon_mode_tooltip: Click to add vertices; Shift aligns a new vertex horizontally or vertically to the previous vertex. Click the first vertex or press Enter to close a filled area. Double click an edge of a finished path to insert a vertex; Shift aligns it to the start of that edge. Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) + drag moves vertices. Backspace removes the last point; Esc cancels. Enable this tool to start a new path.
